title: HDB support for buyers whose BTO flats are completed earlier than expected
asked: Whether HDB will show flexibility to buyers affected by earlier-than-expected BTO completion, including flexibility on the second downpayment timeline, transitional support for young working adults, or other practical arrangements.
response: In 2025, about 30% of BTO blocks were completed earlier than their estimated completion dates at booking, on average about two months earlier. HDB notifies buyers one year, six months and three months before expected completion, and the latest probable completion date is on the MyHDB Page. Buyers must collect keys and pay the balance flat price within a month of the flat being ready. Those facing difficulty from early completion can approach HDB, which may grant key collection deferrals to buyers needing more time to sell an existing flat or arrange financing.

key_points.point: About 30% of BTO blocks in 2025 were completed earlier than the estimated completion date given at flat booking, by about two months on average.
key_points.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
key_points.quote: about 30% of Build-To-Order (BTO) blocks were completed earlier than their estimated completion dates at the point of flat booking

key_points.point: The latest probable completion date is available to buyers through their MyHDB Page account.
key_points.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
key_points.quote: the latest probable completion date is also available to buyers when they log into their accounts on the MyHDB Page

key_points.point: When the flat is ready, buyers must collect keys and pay the balance flat price within one month.
key_points.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
key_points.quote: buyers are required to collect their keys and pay the balance flat price within a month

key_points.point: HDB may defer key collection for buyers who need more time to sell an existing flat or work out financing.
key_points.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
key_points.quote: HDB may provide key collection deferrals to buyers who need additional time to sell their existing flat or work out their financing arrangements

key_points.point: For buyers in financial difficulty who cannot manage back-to-back arrangements, HDB will step in to facilitate an arrangement acceptable to both buyer and seller.
key_points.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
key_points.quote: HDB will step in to see how they can facilitate the arrangements
